name: 701 Sawmill
old_description: With a decade of experience, 701 Sawmill has helped countless customers across North Dakota turn their vision into stunning live edge slab projects. Whether you bring your own log or choose from our large selection of locally milled hardwoods, we’ll custom cut and craft each piece to highlight its natural beauty. From kitchen islands and tables to mantels and countertops, we take pride in creating quality woodwork that stands the test of time.
about:
701 Sawmill operates from Mandan, North Dakota, where it was established in 2016. The company focuses on custom wood milling and live‑edge slab production for customers across the northern Plains.

The shop cuts and dries a rotating inventory of more than 200 live‑edge slabs, sourced from locally harvested hardwoods. Logs brought in by customers are milled to specification on professional‑grade equipment, then kiln‑dried to 8 percent moisture content and flattened on a planer. The output ranges from raw slabs to finished furniture pieces such as tables, countertops, mantels, and shelves. New slabs are continuously added as stock sells, ensuring a broad selection of species and dimensions.

Clients include DIY woodworkers, professional contractors building homes, and craftsmen working on custom projects throughout North Dakota, South Dakota, and Montana. The company serves both residential and light commercial woodworking needs.

Founded on a decade of hands‑on experience, 701 Sawmill emphasizes the natural character of each log, aiming to deliver woodwork that withstands long‑term use.
